benchmark_adaptation_of: GO-water DPMP paper workflow (DOI 10.1021/acs.jpclett.5c03713; dataset 10.6084/m9.figshare.30472487 v2; SI DOI 10.1021/acs.jpclett.5c03713.s001)

public_input.note: Agent-visible inputs: public/system.json only (binding per-system totals, water/hydroxyl/epoxide counts and orthorhombic cells anchored to the author training-dataset measurements; see evidence/refine-2026-08-25/author-dataset-facts.json). NO initial structures, labeled frames, trained model or thresholds are agent-visible - the agent generates every coordinate itself.

public/system.json.role: five interfaces, compositions, cells, oxidation levels

hidden_validation.note: Hidden set = 1412 held-out frames (seed 42, 10%) from the published 14140-frame labeled dataset, drawn per interface into DeepMD raw sets. The agent never sees these frames (they are not in public/). Generator: reference/hidden-validation/generator/generate_hidden_validation.py. density-reference.json is the graphene-water oxygen density profile computed from the published trajectory (first O peak 3.35 A, depletion 2.65 A).

reference/hidden-validation/manifest.jso.role: hidden holdout manifest (five public systems, seed 42)

hidden_validation.per_frame_provenance: manifest.json carries source set + source frame index + coords_hash at 1e-6 precision for every held-out frame (overlap check against candidate submission)
